schema.description:
The enriched, read-time view of an `ALBUM` post's `typeData` — computed
fresh on every read. An album's photos are its `Comment` rows with
`metadata.kind: "album_photo"` (see `Comment` below); this object
aggregates them rather than requiring a second fetch. The full photo
set lives on those comments' `metadata.photoUrls` — fetch the post's
comments to render the whole grid.

closed.description: `true` once the author closed the album (`close` interaction); `addPhotos` is then rejected.

photoCount.description: Total number of photos across every contribution.

contributorCount.description: Number of distinct members who have contributed photos.

contributors.description: Up to 8 distinct contributors, newest first.

collagePhotoUrls.description: Up to the 6 most recent contribution photos, newest first.

schema.title: PostAlbum
